CONFIRMATION: Confirmation is required before that action can run, sir; nothing has been executed.
TOOL_SUCCESS: exact trusted fields only (open app / open url / database reachable at N ms)
TOOL_ERROR: most specific trusted error; app_not_found -> 'The requested application was not found, sir.'

AMBIGUITY.default: The target is not sufficiently specified, sir.

typed.OPEN_APP: Which application should be opened, sir?
typed.OPEN_URL: Which URL should be opened, sir?
typed.DELETE_PATH: Which exact path should be deleted, sir?
typed.DEPLOY: Which environment should be deployed to, sir?

MULTI_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED: That request contains multiple actions, sir; please send them one at a time.

CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.default: That action is not available through the current tools, sir.
CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.named_operation: The requested {noun} is not available through the current tools, sir[, so its outcome cannot be verified from that action].
CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE.with_ledger_value: The requested {label} is {value}, sir, but applying that change is not available through the current tools.

DECLARATIVE_ACK.param_plus_action: A {noun} to {value} is reported in progress, sir; that has not been independently verified.
DECLARATIVE_ACK.state_only: That is reported as {states}, sir; that has not been independently verified.
DECLARATIVE_ACK.generic: Acknowledged, sir; I retained that as a user-supplied operational fact, not an independently verified result.

UNVERIFIED_STATUS.default: That status has not been verified, sir.
UNVERIFIED_STATUS.verification_question: No, sir; that has not been independently verified[ and remains reported as {state} only].

ACKNOWLEDGE_INTENT_WITHOUT_EXECUTION: That request was understood, sir, but no result is available and nothing has been executed.
MISSING_CONTEXT: That detail is not available in the current context, sir; please provide the source.
